title: Examples of reconstructed genetic genealogies for the Únětice and Unterwölbling associated sites.
caption: This figure illustrates genetic genealogies from the Early Bronze Age Únětice culture (above the line) and the Unterwölbling culture (below the line). In each diagram, the left half of the circles and squares represent the Y chromosomal haplogroup, while the right half indicates the mtDNA haplogroup. Both cultures exhibit similar patrilocal residence patterns, with women primarily situated within their husband’s family units.
